The probability is 257/500 = 0.514, which rounds to 0.51.

I counted the respondents who prefer Umami Burger or are female, using P(Umami or Female) = P(Umami) + P(Female) − P(both):

- 6 of the 500 respondents chose Umami Burger.
- 252 of the 500 are female.
- 1 respondent is both, so that person is counted once rather than twice.

That gives 6 + 252 − 1 = 257 respondents out of 500.

ANSWER: 0.51
